stem.text: A wave travels on the surface of water. P, Q, R and S are four particles of water on the surface.
The diagram shows the positions of the particles at one instant. The direction of travel of the wave is from left to right.

stem.alt: Wave drawn as a curve with a dashed horizontal line through its centre. Labelled points P, Q, R and S lie on the curve. An arrow above the wave is labelled direction of wave travel and points to the right.

stem.text: Which two particles are about to move upwards?
